svg.title: Single-ended calibration board: TRL / TRM standards and 2x-Thru on PheroTetra
svg.text: Single-ended calibration board on PheroTetra® FCCL
Port 1 and Port 2 planes coincide at the centre
Open end exactly at each reference plane
Via to ground at each reference plane
TRL · ΔL sets the usable band
Extra length sets the usable band
TRM · matched load at each plane
Matched termination to ground at each plane
Split at the centre: each half models one fixture
TRL / TRM reference plane (= DUT reference plane)
Schematic, not to scale. Line lengths are set from the measured effective Dk of the chosen stack-up; target band and lengths per project.
